name: Zajchik: Okovy T'my
source:
The Petrov family is forced to move to the countryside to settle in an old two-story house inherited from Anton's grandmother. Returning to a place he visited as a child, Anton must do more than just settle in - he must come face to face with his past. He will try to understand himself, unravel the grim secrets of this backwoods, and find common ground with the locals, some of whom are frighteningly strange.

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/chillingtales?w=club221769338]VK[/url]]
